glyph_origin: Pictogram (象形) – a hand grabbing from above (in earlier forms from side); compare 手, 寸, 九. Though it sometimes indicates a claw, the pictogram in actuality depicts a human hand.
senses: [zhuǎ] claw (of animal, bird); talon; paw; nail
(Southern Min) to claw; to scratch (with one's claw or nail)
(Xiamen, &, Quanzhou) classifier for claw or scratch mark
